full_track.tags: Classical solo piano piece transitioning into a contemporary folk-pop arrangement. The first half features a solo grand piano performing intricate, rubato-heavy arpeggios and melodic runs in a style reminiscent of Romantic-era etudes. At the midpoint, the arrangement shifts to a steady 4/4 folk-pop groove at 100 BPM in the key of G Major. An acoustic guitar enters with rhythmic strumming, accompanied by a clean electric bass playing melodic root-fifth patterns. The percussion consists of a soft kick drum on beats 1 and 3 with a subtle shaker and tambourine providing high-frequency rhythmic texture. The piano continues but shifts to a chordal accompaniment role with occasional melodic flourishes. The production is clean with natural room reverb on the piano and a dry, intimate mix for the acoustic guitar and bass.
